status_as_of_cutoff: Local process / preliminary approval: Franklin's Planning and Zoning Commission records list 2026-03-03 agenda/minutes for the project and local reporting states the preliminary development plan was approved with conditions on 2026-03-03. As of the 2026-08-06 Simpson Circuit Court hearing reported by WNKY, the county conditional-use dispute remained unresolved, with Judge Mark A. Thurmond targeting a written opinion before an 2026-10-14 status conference. Developer materials describe the project as in detailed planning/permitting after preliminary approval. No final development plan, conditional-use resolution, building permit, construction start, CO, or energized service was located in this refresh.
evidence_grade: B: official city meeting-index/current-notice pages plus local reporting and developer statements; final permits/construction/energization not verified

contradictions.description: Developer and local-reporting materials commonly describe approximately 200 acres and three 200,000-square-foot facilities, while the accessible complaint copy describes approximately 147 acres and four units for Project Lionsgate/Blackjack. Treat scale as preliminary until final city/court records or final development plans are retrieved.

contradictions.topic: permitted-use city path versus county conditional-use requirement
contradictions.description: Franklin process/reporting treats the project as having a preliminary-plan approval path under city zoning, while the county litigation concerns whether Simpson County can require a conditional use permit inside Franklin city limits. No court ruling resolving this conflict was located.
